title: چرا ژل ناخن زود می‌پره؟ ۵ دلیل

style.look: NOT cartoon, NOT childish. Premium editorial / macro-cinematic look for an adult audience: dark luxury palette (obsidian #0b0a0c, champagne gold #d9b88f, blush #f2c6cf, ivory #f4efe9), thin gold technical line-art, glossy physically-based materials, soft bokeh, film grain, subtle chromatic aberration, anamorphic light streaks. No characters, no mascots, no emoji, no real human skin or faces (avoid uncanny realism: show nails as glossy objects and technical cross-sections).
style.tools: Three.js with MeshPhysicalMaterial (transmission, clearcoat, iridescence, thickness), procedural/studio environment lighting, post-processing (bloom, depth of field, grain) via the 'postprocessing' package; SVG for technical drawings with stroke-dash draw-on; GSAP paused timelines driven by window.__seek(t); seeded particles. SwiftShader WebGL in headless Chromium is enabled. Everything deterministic.
style.typography: Big confident Persian kinetic type (Vazirmatn ExtraBold) with the karaoke yellow word-pill as defined in README; secondary labels thin and small, never covering the product. Keep text in safe zones.
style.motion: Slow-motion hero moments + sharp speed-ramps; macro push-ins, orbits, crane-ups, rack focus; every scene has a continuous camera move and at least 3 moving layers; transitions via light sweeps and match cuts on glossy highlights.
style.audio: Minimal ambient pad + soft pulse (bpm 80-90), liquid/glass/click SFX; calm authoritative voice (see voice-prompts.md). Set brand.json music.bpm to 84 for this reel.

accuracy: Educational claims must stay general and cautious: these are COMMON reasons for gel lifting (skin/oil left on the nail surface, thick or under-cured layers, unsealed free edge, using nails as tools). Do not promise exact durations or medical results.
goal: High-save, high-share educational reel. 30-38 s. Hook = relatable pain in 1 s, one reason per scene, satisfying macro visuals, 'save + send' CTA. Loop back to the droplet.

scenes.idea: Pure black void. A single gel droplet (clear, amber-tinted, physically-based glass/gel material) falls in extreme slow motion through a hard champagne-gold rim light and lands on a mirror-black glossy plate; ripple rings expand, then a hairline crack races across the glossy surface and a corner lifts. Macro depth of field, light streak flare. Kinetic type slams in word by word.

scenes.text: دلیل اول: چربی نامرئی روی سطح ناخن
scenes.idea: Technical cross-section drawing animates on dark navy-black: thin gold line draws the nail plate profile (stroke draw-on), tiny glowing oil dots drift on its surface; a translucent gel layer hovers and fails to bond, leaving a shimmering air gap; thin leader lines with small labels pop. Subtle grid, parallax camera drift, shallow DOF on background dots.

scenes.text: دلیل دوم: پوست نازکی که روی ناخن می‌مونه
scenes.idea: Same technical language: a near-invisible translucent film (cuticle remnant) shown as a shimmering sheet over the nail plate; gel is applied on top and the film peels at the edge like a corner of tape, the gel layer rolls up with it; highlight ring pulses on the lift point. Slow push-in with rack focus.

scenes.text: دلیل سوم: لایه‌ی ضخیم و کم‌پخت
scenes.idea: Side-by-side exploded stack view: thin even layers glowing evenly vs one thick layer with trapped micro-bubbles and an under-cured soft core (gradient from glossy top to dull milky bottom), a heat-map style color scan sweeps through. Layers animate apart and snap back. Orbit camera 20 degrees.

scenes.text: دلیل چهارم: لبه‌ی ناخن که سیل نشده
scenes.idea: Side profile of the nail tip: blue water droplets creep in through the unsealed free edge as an animated liquid-capillary line crawling under the gel; then the edge gets a gold sealing cap sweep and the water bounces off in slow motion. Macro close-up, light sweep across the seal.

scenes.text: دلیل پنجم: استفاده از ناخن به‌جای ابزار
scenes.idea: Dramatic slow-motion: a nail edge forced under a metallic can-tab like a lever; red force arrows and a stress heat-map bloom on the nail; a crack propagates through the gel like glass, fragments float in micro-gravity with bright rim light. Hard screen shake on the impact, bass hit.

scenes.text: اجرای درست، به ماندگاری بیشتر کمک می‌کنه
scenes.idea: Resolution: a perfect almond nail as a glossy macro object on dark glass, clearcoat reflections, a slow light sweep and an iridescent chrome-powder glint travelling across it; floating gold dust, camera crane-up, very calm; reflections ripple on the plate below.

scenes.text: ذخیره کن و برای کسی بفرست که ناخنش همیشه می‌پره
scenes.idea: Elegant minimal end: kinetic type 'ذخیره کن' with a bookmark icon draw-on, a send-arrow draws and flies; a gold liquid sweep wipes into the end-card @ayda.nailroom on black with a soft glint on the lettering. Loop: the opening droplet appears as the last beat.
